items.title: Artists Take to the Streets Amid Massive Protests in France
items.summary: Tens of thousands gathered at Porte d’Italie in Paris for a march led in part by culture-sector coalitions demanding a better life for artists.

items.title: Kid Cudi to Write, Direct, and Star as Basquiat in New Biopic
items.summary: The rapper called his forthcoming film, "JEAN," a “love letter” to the late artist and ’80s New York in his announcement on October 21.

items.title: The Center Cannot Hold at the Toronto Biennial
items.summary: It’s a provocative and discursive exploration of how artists respond to our late-capitalist epoch, but its focus on “rupture” raises questions.

items.title: Scientists Contest Dating of Van Gogh’s "The Starry Night"
items.summary: The researchers identified discrepancies between the celestial alignments in June 1889 and Vincent van Gogh’s painted night sky.
